# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as having considerable weight, making the idea of her playing a slender fairy queen seem absurd to her classmates.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie possesses an unpleasant, moody, and haughty disposition. She is bold and never hesitant to ask questions, yet she is widely known for her malicious nature and caustic tongue. She is also superstitious, holding beliefs about bad luck attached to specific numbers, and lacks a creative mind.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## History

While attending school in Brierley under Miss Thorne, Flossie successfully walked the crest of the Pembroke garden fence after being challenged by Nell Harcourt. She became moody after being passed over for the role of fairy queen in a school dialogue, giving spiteful grins during public occasions and causing a three-month feud with Julia Bell by making a rude comment about her bow. At the local exhibition, she won the top prize for knitted lace. Flossie joined the Regent's class to prepare for entrance examinations, which she passed by a narrow three-point margin. She went on to attend Regent's Academy, residing at a lodging house alongside Frank Stockley and earning a reputation for being the most caustic-tongued young woman at the academy. Later, when Nell published a prize story, Flossie disdainfully accused her of plagiarizing it, and she continued to eavesdrop on telephone calls with her sister back in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v4 c1 P13](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0013)_
